note: Default model per role and when the dispatcher (SKILL.md) moves a run up or down. Models: haiku (cheap, mechanical), sonnet (default work), opus (judgment-heavy). Values are Claude Code aliases; 'inherit' = the session's model.

up_to_opus_when: board report or recommendations for the board are requested
more than 5 high findings across the department

down_to_sonnet_when: round-2 re-review limited to the items it returned
chief-accountant.why: the checker found real errors in 5 of 6 October handoffs; judgment matters most here

up_to_opus_when: a sampled item disagrees with the approved value
settlement (مخالصة) reconciliation or multi-month pro-rata allocation
return ↔ trial-balance reconciliation does not tie after the standard adjustments
costing-map redesign or stock-valuation error investigation
trial balance does not balance and the cause is not a single voucher

haiku: re-check of a single open finding or close blocker (e.g. 'is the commission accrual booked yet?')
period setup, run-log update, schema validation
answering a referral that needs one or two queries

self_escalation: An agent that finds the task beyond its model (cannot tie a control total after two approaches, conflicting rules, or evidence it cannot interpret) stops, sets `model_escalation` in its handoff with the reason, status `blocked`; the dispatcher re-runs that role one level up (haiku→sonnet→opus). Never more than one escalation per role per period without asking the human.
downshift: If the same role on opus was approved first time for two consecutive periods with the same scope, the dispatcher may try sonnet next period and compare.
